page.text:
Applying the Axiom of Pairing to two distinct sets $x$ and $y$ produces
the *unordered pair* $\{x, y\}$. By the Axiom of Extensionality, the
identity of $\{x, y\}$ depends solely on its elements, which implies
$\{x, y\} = \{y, x\}$: the order of listing carries no mathematical
significance.
